How your farm grows

01 Feed and wander Each hen lays an egg after 100 meals, with an adult rooster in the yard. One eaten grain counts as one meal.

02 A little arrival Eggs hatch on their own in 3 minutes while the chickens roam. Tap an egg to see how soon your chick will arrive.

03 Room to grow After 200 meals, a chick grows into an adult. There is room for 16 birds and eggs.

04 A passing foxEvery two active minutes, a fox visits and carries one adult chicken away. The loss is permanent. The last hen and rooster are protected; fox visits pause when you leave the farm or pause its animation.
